decisions.question: Where should the 40M-row backfill run?

options.label: Online job after the release
options.gain: No lock on invoices; it can pause and resume.
options.cost: About 3 hours before every row has cents.

options.label: Inline in the release pipeline
options.gain: Done when the release is done.
options.cost: Locks invoices for minutes on 40M rows.

decisions.why: 40M rows is too many for one locking update during the release.
decisions.next: The backfill part is rewritten for the way you pick.

blocks.title: The backfill
blocks.markdown: Migration `0042` only adds the `amount_cents` column. How the **40 million** old rows get filled in waits on the question above.
